children: Warren Buffett has stepped down as Berkshire Hathaway chairman after more than six decades at the company and is now chairman emeritus, while Howard Buffett takes over the board and Greg Abel remains chief executive, according to Bloomberg.
Howard Buffett, a Berkshire director since 1993, is tasked with safeguarding the conglomerate’s culture and values as the company completes its long-planned leadership transition.

title: Berkshire Names Howard Buffett Chair as Warren Buffett Steps Down
